headline: President Clinton ordered federal agencies to work toward giving more government contracting opportunities to small businesses owned by women.
what_it_does: This executive order directs federal agencies to increase opportunities for women-owned small businesses, likely in winning government contracts. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, goals, and requirements for agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They may have more chances to compete for and win work from federal agencies.
They are directed to take steps to expand opportunities for women-owned small businesses.
